verdict: Spending $7,221 produced only 2 leads this period while the main search campaign sits paused — pipeline is effectively stalled.
diagnosis: Cost per lead landed near $3,610 this period, roughly 10x the healthcare benchmark, driven by heavy spend against almost no conversions.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads in 28 days
signals.detail: Spend reached $7,221 but produced just two leads. The paid funnel is not generating pipeline at a usable rate.

signals.headline: Main call campaign paused mid-period
signals.detail: The retargeting call campaign is paused. That likely explains the collapse in impressions and clicks toward period end.

signals.headline: 9 purchases returned $5,897 in revenue
signals.detail: Purchases are the only bright spot, averaging $655 each. Shopping intent is converting even as lead flow dries up.

signals.headline: 183 direction requests, 1 call click
signals.detail: The Google Business Profile drives foot-traffic intent but almost no phone calls. A call-tracking gap is likely.

signals.headline: Click-through rate holding at 0.08%
signals.detail: Click-through is weak for search. Creative and keyword relevance need review before relaunching the paused campaign.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Industry data puts healthcare cost per lead at roughly $130–$350 in 2026, with consumer health and wellness closer to $98. Liferun's current cost per lead is far above both ranges.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Q4 Medicare window lifts senior demand
seasonal.body: Medicare Advantage open enrollment runs through December. Adult children researching medical alerts for aging parents peaks now — a window Liferun's paused campaigns are missing.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Apple Watch ranks as the most-used medical alert device among older adults, ahead of dedicated brands like Life Alert and Medical Guardian. Price and feature differentiation matters more than ever.

recommendations.title: Relaunch the paused call campaign before Medicare window closes
recommendations.detail: The retargeting call campaign is paused during peak senior shopping season. Consider restarting with a tighter budget cap and clear daily lead target.

recommendations.title: Fix call tracking on the Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: 183 direction requests but only 1 call click suggests tracking is broken or the call button is buried. Worth auditing the profile this week.

recommendations.title: Shift budget toward purchase-driving ads
recommendations.detail: Purchases returned $5,897 on modest spend. Test reallocating budget from lead forms into the shopping funnel that is already converting.
